5295.title: Cached runtime executable breaks new provider workers
5295.rootCauseOneLine: The agent runtime caches the resolved Node executable and reuses the removed target for new provider workers after its stable alias is retargeted.
5295.proposedFix: Preserve a stable trusted runtime reference end to end and validate compatible replacements before worker startup, retaining GUI/Electron behavior and specific runtime errors.
5295.caveats: Twice reproduced at the real shared runtime model-discovery boundary on Linux using identical Node copies and the repository scripted provider. No enrolled Mac/Homebrew transaction or authenticated Codex/Claude integration was run. No PR: launcher propagation and compatibility policy exceed the one-subsystem simple-fix gate.
